newsitem.title: USA: Armstrong World extends Domco offer.
newsitem.headline: Armstrong World extends Domco offer.

text.p: Armstrong World Industries Inc said Friday it will extend through October 10 its all-cash offer to buy shares of Domco Inc at C$23 each.
The offer, which has been rejected by Domco, had been scheduled to expire on August 15.
Armstrong said the extension will give it time to have its case heard in an Ontario court.
It said it is "firmly committed" to its offer for Domco and is prepared to pursue it over the "long term."

Armstrong has filed suit against the Domco board, alleging it has breached its fiduciary duty by failing to obtain value for all Domco shareholders. Armstrong requested that the board be replaced with independent directors selected by the court.
Armstrong said it seeks a court order directing the Domco board to issue new shares so as to permit Armstrong's bid for the company to succeed.
French concern Sommer Allibert, which holds 69.2 percent of Domco's shares, or 57.1 percent fully diluted, has said it will not sell its Domco shares to Armstrong.
